title: Budget modes change one scope, not the whole cascade
subtitle: Merged P46 · strict is the default. An owner can add allowance or notify for a unit or team. Allocation, entitlement, the organisation ceiling and personal controls remain separate.

groups.title: Request policy · evaluate assigned scope and parent independently

nodes.title: 1 · Choose scope behavior
lines: Catalog [[enforcement]]
[[percent]]: integer 1-100, only with allowance
Admin choice; managers cannot change modes.

nodes.title: 2 · Validate before any write
lines: [[converter]]
Invalid mode metadata defers the complete apply.
Freshness guard rereads source revisions; changed source is replanned.

nodes.title: 3 · Publish separate settings
lines: Base budget B stays in [[registry]].
Only exceptions belong in [[modes]].
Missing mode means strict; [[parents]] still defines the parent.

nodes.title: 4 · Resolve [[mode]] and [[parent-mode]]
lines: Each scope reads its own base budget and mode. An absent or malformed gateway entry falls back to strict.
A base budget of zero still means no monthly scope limiter is configured.

nodes.title: Strict · default
lines: Monthly limit = B
[[limit]] uses the existing scope counter key.
Quota exhaustion returns 403 naming the budget.
This remains an approximate token cap, not an invoice guarantee.

nodes.title: Allowance · bounded extra tokens
lines: Monthly limit = B + floor(B x percent / 100), capped at the integer maximum.
Same counter key; no new allowance counter.
Estimated remainder can produce an advisory above the base budget.
Extended quota exhaustion still refuses.

nodes.title: Notify · skip this limiter
lines: No monthly limiter or monthly remainder counter at this scope.
A nonzero notify budget adds an advisory on successful responses, even before 100%.
Never manufacture an unlimited quota.
Parent and other controls still apply.

nodes.title: 5 · Keep the other boundaries
lines: [[org]], the other unit/team scope, tier TPM, personal daily quota and request rate remain independent.
Allocation headroom and manager authorization do not change.

nodes.title: 6 · Advisory response, not exact crossing
lines: [[notice]]
Allowance uses [[remaining]] / [[parent-remaining]] estimates. Notify reports usage without claiming the budget was crossed.
A Claude client may not display this header.

nodes.title: 7 · Keep usage reporting separate from enforcement
lines: Non-strict modes emit [[trace]] with both scopes' modes and base budgets.
[[join]] joins usage without duplicating the existing identity trace keyed by [[legacy-join]].
Changing back from notify does not reconstruct tokens skipped by that scope's counter. Use the ledger for reporting.

notice: Soft counters, streaming estimates and omitted cache tokens still apply. Notify is not an exact over-budget detector. The pre-write revision check mitigates stale runs, but separate reads and writes are not atomic or a serialized queue.
